information_need: Reports that a Garmin watch cannot transfer or synchronize data with the app; successful sync alone is not relevant.
Pairing or discovering a watch fails or requires repeated attempts after an app update.
The Garmin Connect app consumes excessive phone battery; watch battery complaints without an app connection are only partly relevant.
The app crashes or closes when launched, rather than during an unrelated operation.
Phone messages or alerts do not reach the watch through the app.
Complaints about a subscription or paywall for Garmin Connect features.
The redesigned app interface makes navigation or finding information harder.
Problems signing in to an existing account or resetting a password.
The Bluetooth connection between a Garmin device and phone repeatedly drops or fails to stay connected.
A recorded activity is absent from Garmin Connect even after a sync attempt.
Activities fail to transfer from Garmin Connect to Strava; generic sync issues without Strava are only partly relevant.
Sleep duration, sleep stages or sleep times are missing or inaccurate in Garmin Connect.
Heart-rate data or graphs are absent or fail to load in the app.
Step counts do not refresh, sync correctly or agree between the device and app.
The app is slow to launch, load pages or show data; crashes alone are only partly relevant.
An app screen becomes stuck or unresponsive, rather than merely having a disliked design.
Restoring a watch connection requires reinstalling the app or repeated unpairing and pairing.
A Fenix device has a reported app sync failure; another device's sync issue is only partly relevant.
A Forerunner device cannot pair or remain paired with Garmin Connect.
A reviewer reports an iPhone-to-Garmin connection failure following an update.
A planned workout cannot be sent from Garmin Connect to the watch.
Training plans or scheduled workouts are absent from or incorrect in the app calendar.
A route or course cannot be transferred between the app and a Garmin device.
A reviewer explicitly reports that an update restored a previously failing connection or sync; hopes or claims that it is still broken are not directly relevant.
